pages.text: Abandoned Assembly Chambers generate beneath new terrain in The Slimic. Lamps mark the entrance stair. $(l:world/kingdom_maps)Sanctum$() and mine supplies may contain an Assembly Clue. Use it in this dimension to mark a nearby candidate chamber.

The clue is no key. Use the Assembly Core to begin a two-second awakening. The first attempt and retries after failure are free. The stair stays open; retreating for a minute while the encounter remains loaded resets it.

After a victory, the same altar asks for eight slimeballs and two Old Command Fragments, after one day. Server settings can change these costs. Each participant claims a personal reward at a core; full bags keep the reward pending.

In Peaceful, no colony awakens. Eight Old Command Fragments and 32 slimeballs unlock your first reward at that chamber once. A replacement core at the original altar restores access; any assembly core can deliver pending personal rewards.
